steps.title: Pick up the Usurper, party around her
steps.cue: Usurper of Frost appears in the centre
steps.rule: Healers and ranged stand behind her to the south.

MainTank.rule: Tank her 4m north of the centre. Invuln just before the first Quadruple Slap so it covers the second too.

OffTank.rule: Stand beside the main tank. Provoke once the second slap lands: the main tank carries its vulnerability.
